PlayerController.getAbilityToPlay(hostCard, abilities, triggerEvent): multi -> external; single -> automatic (broker.recordAutomatic). CloneEffect/CopyPermanentEffect copy-decisions and chooseOptionalAdditionalCosts route through here.

PlayerControllerHuman.chooseOptionalCosts: GUI multi-select over engine list.
PlayerController.declareAttackers(attacker, combat): CombatUtil.canAttack legality both axes.
PlayerController.declareBlockers(defender, combat): CombatUtil.canBlock legality.
PlayerController.chooseSpellAbilityToPlay -> Broker.choosePriority: nativeOptions from Card.getAllPossibleAbilities(actor, true) incl. alternative-cost variants; PASS o0 = decline.
PlaySpellAbility.playSpellAbility executes natively.

Same applyManaToCost surface: each offered option IS a native mana source ability (host card + ability identity projected).
PlayerController.chooseBinary(sa, question, kindOfChoice, defaultChoice): native yes/no externalized (defaultChoice NOT auto-applied; both options offered).

forge_native: PlayerController.chooseSingleReplacementEffect(possibleReplacers): 0 -> fail-closed; 1 -> automatic record; >=2 -> external REPL choice over engine-identified effects.
RQ-C1 A04 asserts exactly 2 legal orders (Hardened Scales vs Doubling Season).

PlayerController.chooseSingleCardForZoneChange / chooseCardsForZoneChange(destination, origin, sa, fetchList, ...): engine-authoritative fetchList; optional NONE / DONE discipline; exact index binding.
PlayerController.chooseTargetsFor: candidates = TargetRestrictions.getAllCandidates filtered by canTarget + already-targeted exclusion; DONE offered iff >= minTargets.
PlayerController.chooseTarget(sa, allTargets pairs): 1 -> automatic; >=2 -> TARGETPAIR choice.
PlayerController.orderSimultaneousSa(activePlayerSAs): 0/1 -> automatic; exactly 2 -> external binary ORDER choice; >2 -> MORE_THAN_TWO fail-closed.
orderAndPlaySimultaneousSa replays the ordered list through PlaySpellAbility.playSpellAbility with NON_NATIVE_TRIGGER guard.
